title: Unitree H1-2 with Inspire hands (39 actuators), route contact variant solref 0.00125 s (Alloy's route step only)
licence: BSD-3-Clause (unitreerobotics/unitree_ros h1_2_description; gains: gym-anything/robotics h1_2, MIT)
world: floor z = 0; box obstacle 0.3 x 0.3 x 0.1 m at x = 1 m
changes: visual-only geoms and their meshes, materials and textures dropped

source keyframes dropped; keyframe 'init' = start state (robot start pose, ctrl = its joint targets, objects at rest), both clipped into the joint ranges; free-floating robots lifted so the deepest floor contact just touches
collision hulls above 64 vertices split into convex pieces within 0.2 mm (hull_split.json)

robot self-pairs overlapping > 0.5 mm at the start pose, or at qpos0 (where alloy.build starts a robot), excluded: H1-2's wrist yaw | thumb proximal, each hand; the Franka arms' link5 | hand (Panda) or link7 (FR3), whose hulls overlap 5.6-43 mm at qpos0 and 15-33 mm at joint6's lower limit; none elsewhere
options: jacobian sparse; <flag multiccd="disable"/> written out (Alloy's MJCF route, as for T12: Newton reads an absent flag as off, MuJoCo as on; explicit, both read off)

H1-2 leg and torso servos (hips, knees, ankles, torso: 13): kp and kd x 16 (ankle pitch 60 -> 960 N m/rad, knee 300 -> 4800). The forklift profile's gains hold a seated operator; standing, two ankles at kp 60 give 120 N m/rad against the 590 that keep it from tipping, so it lay flat by 2 s and landed 20-33 mm deep in the floor. It now stands (deepest contact 0.33 mm). Force limits and the arm, hand and head servos are the profile's (alloy.tasks.emb_robots.STAND_GAIN)

route contact variant of emb_e7_h1_2: every geom's solref set to [0.00125, 1.0] (time constant = 2 x Alloy's route step 0.000625 s, MuJoCo's floor; damping ratio); a solimp softer than MuJoCo's default (dmin < 0.9; Go2's feet) set to the default, as in _stiff; friction, margins, stiffer solimp and everything else as the verdict scene

contact.valid: valid at Alloy's route step (0.000625 s) only: an engine at the sources' 2 ms step clamps the time constant to 4 ms (MuJoCo's 2 dt floor)
